caseName: Baney v. Merit Systems Protection Board
caseNameFull: Baney v. Merit Systems Protection Board

opinions.text:
C. A. Fed. Cir. Motion of petitioner for reconsideration of order *1195denying leave to proceed informa pauperis [ante, p. 1001] denied. Motion for leave to proceed as a veteran granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and this petition.
